name: What is the difference between a screened porch and a full patio enclosure?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a screened porch and a full patio enclosure?

acceptedAnswer.text: A screened porch typically features an open structure with screen panels designed to keep insects out while allowing maximum airflow. A full patio enclosure, conversely, often incorporates glass or solid panels, providing greater protection from varying weather conditions, dust, and temperature fluctuations, allowing for year-round use. AKN Design Group can guide you in selecting the option that best suits your desired level of weather protection, climate control, and overall functionality for your high-end outdoor living space.
acceptedAnswer.description: A screened porch offers insect protection and airflow, while a full patio enclosure provides greater weather and temperature protection for year-round use.
